text:
diego (Eng): Hey — lab billed me full price because they said no PCP referral was on file. I thought my PCP on the digital card was Dr. Chen. Claim #997771234. Attached EOB and screenshot of my ID card showing PCP: Dr. Mei Chen.

tessa (People Ops): Sorry about that. Which Redwood plan are you on? Some HSA plans require a referral to get in-network lab rates.

diego (Eng): I'm on Redwood Select HSA (RW-HSA-2025). I uploaded EOB.pdf and idcard.png. The EOB lists patient as covered but says "no referral on file" and billed out-of-network.

benefits-bot: Plan lookup: RW-HSA-2025 (UnitedCare Select Network). Referral requirement: outpatient lab tests may require PCP authorization depending on CPT code. Member PCP on record: Dr. Mei Chen (NPI 555444333). Member canonical ID: UC-0005501234. Appeals/reaudit portal: https://unitedcare.example/appeals.

tessa (People Ops): Likely causes: 1) referral wasn't submitted by the PCP prior to service; 2) provider billed under a vendor that needs separate referral routing; 3) PCP assignment changed recently and insurer's portal not refreshed. I'll check PCP assignment and ask the broker to confirm whether this CPT needed pre-authorization.

morgan (Broker): Hi all — I can ping UnitedCare and the PCP office to check if a referral exists. If not, we can request retro auth or claim reprocessing with a PCP attestation. Useful docs: EOB, ID card, lab order/referral (if you have it), and date of service.

diego (Eng): I have the lab order email from Dr. Chen's portal. Uploading lab_order.pdf now. Can you paste a short appeal text I can submit?

tessa (People Ops): Paste this into UnitedCare portal or read to the rep:

"""
To UnitedCare Member Services,

Please review Claim #997771234 for outpatient lab services dated 2025-06-02 billed by North Labs. Member: diego (Eng), Plan: Redwood Select HSA (RW-HSA-2025). The claim was adjudicated as out-of-network due to 'no referral on file'. The member's PCP is Dr. Mei Chen (NPI 555444333) and the lab was ordered via the PCP portal on 2025-05-30 (order attached). Please reprocess the claim under in-network benefits or accept a retroactive PCP attestation and adjust member liability accordingly. Attached: EOB, digital ID card screenshot, lab order PDF.

Thank you,
[Member Name]
"""

benefits-bot: Appeal started: UnitedCare Case UCARE-2025-0605-9910. Submitter: diego (Eng). Link: https://unitedcare.example/cases/UCARE-2025-0605-9910.

anya (Finance): If you paid up front, Finance can do a temporary reimbursement while appeal is open. DM me the receipt and amount and Ill process.

diego (Eng): Thanks everyone 44d Will wait for the case update and please cc me on any broker-insurer messages.
